text:
Maria: quick random q — if you could stash one 'secret' thing in your suitcase that somehow takes zero extra space, what would it be? asking for future-me 😅
Jasper: portable espresso tamper. can't travel without a decent shot. :coffee:
Devon: noise-canceling earbuds. actual sanity saver on flights.
Sam: a tiny, indestructible paperback of 'The Hobbit' (no kindle nostalgia).
Katie: a travel-sized steamer that also folds into a postcard pls
Nina: an extra hour tacked onto every day. non-negotiable. :clock1:
Jasper: @Nina you monster, sell me that app lol
Maria: someone suggested a 'duplicate clothes' item so you never have to do laundry. 10/10
ops-bot: Reminder: office move boxes go out Friday :package:
Devon: also, a universal charging cable that never tangles. magic.
Sam: vote — which is the most useful? 1) espresso 2) earbuds 3) universal cable 4) extra hour. react with 1-4
Katie: 3 :+1:
Nina: 4 🙋‍♀️
Jasper: 1 and 2 tie, I'm greedy :grin:
Maria: log this for future retreat swag ideas 😂
